items.a: Hi, I'm Mark. I work in General Administration at a logistics company under Coupang. I handle procurement for operations, including MRO supplies, and I manage the cleaning staff and oversee our vendors. I also monitor catering data to control costs and service quality.
items.aZh: 嗨，我是 Mark。我在 Coupang 旗下的物流公司擔任總務，負責營運採購（包含 MRO 耗材），管理清潔人員並督導廠商，也會追蹤餐飲數據以控管成本與服務品質。

items.q: Why are you interested in this position?
items.qZh: 你為什麼對這個職位有興趣？
items.a: In my current role, I work with vendors every day, and I enjoy solving problems with them. This position would let me work with global supply chain partners, which is the next step I want to take in my career.
items.aZh: 我目前每天都和廠商合作，也很享受和他們一起解決問題。這個職位能讓我與全球供應鏈夥伴合作，這是我職涯想邁出的下一步。

items.q: Tell me about a time you had a problem with a vendor.
items.qZh: 請分享一次你和廠商遇到問題的經驗。
items.a: Recently, my supervisor and I found a theft issue. Some swing-shift cleaning staff were taking cola from a restricted area. We retrained the staff and worked with the security team by email to improve monitoring. Since then, we haven't had any more cases.
items.aZh: 最近我和主管發現一起偷竊問題：部分小夜班清潔人員從管制區拿走可樂。我們重新培訓人員，並透過 email 與保全團隊合作加強監控，之後就沒有再發生。

items.q: How do you handle a delayed delivery?
items.a: First, I contact the vendor to confirm the new ETA and the reason for the delay. Then I let the internal team know so they can adjust their plans. If it keeps happening, I review the vendor's performance and look for a backup supplier.
items.aZh: 首先聯絡廠商確認新的預計到貨時間與延遲原因，接著通知內部團隊調整計畫。如果一再發生，我會檢討廠商績效並尋找備援供應商。

items.q: Your English isn't perfect. How will you communicate with global vendors?
items.qZh: 你的英文不算完美，要如何與國際廠商溝通？
items.a: I'm actively improving my English every day. For important topics, I always confirm details in writing by email, so nothing gets lost. And if I'm not sure, I ask them to clarify. I'd rather double-check than make a mistake.
items.aZh: 我每天都在積極加強英文。重要事項我一定用 email 書面確認細節，避免遺漏；不確定時我會請對方說明清楚。我寧可多確認一次，也不要出錯。
